chapters.title: 八个观测，只产生一个样本均值
chapters.en: Eight observations produce one sample mean.

chapters.title: 换一整份样本，才得到下一个均值
chapters.en: A new sample gives the next sample mean.

chapters.title: 很多个均值，才形成抽样分布
chapters.en: The distribution is built from repeated sample means.

chapters.title: n 控制每个均值，B 控制模拟精细度
chapters.en: Sample size and repetition count play different roles.
